features.label: Simplified forms
features.explanation: Simplify existing forms into clear color fields, keeping their contours readable
features.evidence: Fine gold lines trace leaf veins and branches; curling lines within the clouds turn natural forms into decorative patterns.
features.zh: 以清楚色面概括原有形体，保持轮廓可读
features.en: Simplify existing forms into clear color fields, keeping their contours readable

features.label: Fine gold lines
features.explanation: Place delicate, fine gold lines along existing contours and structures
features.evidence: Fine gold lines trace leaf veins and branches; curling lines within the clouds turn natural forms into decorative patterns.
features.zh: 沿原有轮廓与结构布置轻盈的细金线
features.en: Place delicate, fine gold lines along existing contours and structures

features.label: Bright blues and greens
features.explanation: Create a bright color relationship with cobalt blue, richly varied greens and ivory
features.evidence: Cobalt blue sky and richly varied greens establish the main color relationship, while ivory flowers and gold lines suggest daylight.
features.zh: 以钴蓝、层次丰富的绿色和象牙白形成明亮关系
features.en: Create a bright color relationship with cobalt blue, richly varied greens and ivory

features.label: Soft daylight
features.explanation: Render clear, soft daylight, avoiding harsh metallic highlights
features.evidence: Cobalt blue sky and richly varied greens establish the main color relationship, while ivory flowers and gold lines suggest daylight.
features.zh: 呈现清透而柔和的日光，避免强烈金属高光
features.en: Render clear, soft daylight, avoiding harsh metallic highlights

features.label: Flatness and depth
features.explanation: Keep the original perspective, creating depth through a decorative foreground and a simpler distance
features.evidence: The foreground leaves resemble flat ornament, while the woodland, stream and hillside retain depth; detail is concentrated in the vegetation and contours.
features.zh: 保留原有透视，以装饰性前景与较简洁远景形成层次
features.en: Keep the original perspective, creating depth through a decorative foreground and a simpler distance

features.label: Handmade patterns
features.explanation: Give repeated patterns subtle handmade variations, avoiding uniform duplication
features.evidence: Dense yet distinct repetitions of plants, tiny flowers and brushwork on a paper-like surface create a handmade appearance reminiscent of wallpaper or tapestry.
features.zh: 让重复纹样带有轻微手工变化，避免整齐复制
features.en: Give repeated patterns subtle handmade variations, avoiding uniform duplication

features.label: Peaceful pastoral mood
features.explanation: Create a fresh, peaceful and idealized atmosphere
features.evidence: A fresh, peaceful, idealized pastoral world. When transferring the style, prioritize preserving the original scene; there is no need to add streams or mushrooms.
features.zh: 营造清新、宁静、理想化的氛围
features.en: Create a fresh, peaceful and idealized atmosphere

features.label: Keep the original palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only tonal values and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional creative variation, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only tonal values and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
